svg.text: SUBAGENTS — each with its own tools, prompt and evidence bar
GATES — nothing advances without passing the one before it
The subagents exist to keep the main context clean: each returns a CONCLUSION,
not the files it read. The gates exist because the model's confidence is
uncorrelated with correctness — only the gate output counts.
Memory is what survives the session. A lesson not written into CLAUDE.md or a runbook
in the same session it was learned is a lesson the next session will pay for again.
